rules.std20: population standard deviation of current-inclusive last20 closes, ddof=0: sqrt(sum((close_i-middle)^2)/20)
rules.entry: close <= lower AND close > current-inclusive SMA(close,200). Close touch, not intraday low touch. Inclusive lower-band comparison; strict trend comparison.
rules.exit: close >= middle (inclusive return/touch to middle band)
rules.warmup: full200 observed bars required for entry; first eligible index199. BB requires20 observed closes.
rules.execution: completed daily close signals fill next available symbol session open; one long per symbol; flat entry versus held exit state; no added stop/risk filter
rules.overlap: if flat and entry true, schedule entry even if exit also true; if held evaluate exit; earliest post-entry exit is next open after entry-day close; after open exit reentry may be scheduled at that close for following open
rules.terminal: no forced liquidation; open positions marked separately; final close entry/exit signals pending and unfilled
rules.portfolio_DD: unavailable, no sizing/capital constraints/portfolio mark-to-market equity model
rules.coverage: same692 current exact-universe Turso stocks; 52 missing and seven stale excluded; no aliases, no new Fyers requests
limitations: fixed present-day mirrored universe causes survivorship bias
mixed-source Turso corporate-action adjustment consistency not independently verified
missing sessions can distort channel/SMA windows; full200bar entry warmup
zero costs and unconstrained concurrent capital limit practical conclusions

caveats: Historical closed-trade arithmetic statistics, not portfolio returns. Open trades excluded. No equal-capital sizing, compounding, equity curve, CAGR, or portfolio drawdown.
Gross zero costs; present-day universe survivorship bias; mixed-source corporate-action adjustments and missing sessions remain unverified. Extreme returns are data-sensitive, not recommendations.
